mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_session (session_id, user_id, title, kb_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{kbId}, NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, kb_id = EXCLUDED.kb_id, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, user_id, title, kb_id, created_at, updated_at FROM chat_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.session_id, s.user_id, s.title, s.kb_id, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM chat_session s LEFT JOIN chat_message m ON m.session_id = s.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND (s.title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.content ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
